title: Black Hole
selectSource: Pick a fan top to absorb into the black hole (±1 rank, any suit)

tutorial.board: The central black hole and 17 fans of three. Only the top card of each fan can be moved.
tutorial.rules: A fan top can be absorbed when its rank is one away from the black hole top (any suit, no King-Ace wrap). Absorb all 52 cards to win.
tutorial.actionButtons: Buttons for hint, undo, give up and more.

frontendHint.blackholePlayFan: The top card of this fan can go into the hole
